# The swarm example is a valid workflow file. The check reads the files only: it starts no agent, no forge and no tracker.
# The check covers the names and keywords of builtin calls. It does not see a misspelled field of a result, such as out.rejectd.
isolate

example swarm/workflow.star
example swarm/project.star config/projects/swarm.star
example swarm/prompts/task.md

exec obeereal check workflow swarm/workflow.star
! stdout .
! stderr .
